[P2] Revisit the disposal approach under rule 2

Rule 2, **Simplify before you add**, requires the description to identify simpler options and explain why they cannot cover the fix. This change adds disposal checks in four methods, but the description only describes those checks and queue reuse; it does not evaluate simplifying the existing termination/disposal logic. The additional lifecycle conditions therefore lack the required justification. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6: consider centralizing the lifecycle transition and queue cleanup, compare that direction with these guards, and obtain agreement on the chosen approach before revising the code.
